_about: Who each tracklet is, by camera. Tracklet ids come from demo/tracks.py run on data/pose/261456/<cam>.npz; changing the tracker renumbers them. Checked by eye from contact sheets, 2026-11-03. 'default' applies to unnamed tracklets of at least default_min_frames frames; 'ignore' hides a tracklet (reflections in the observation window, objects). 'head_direction': compute the head-direction lane on this camera (faces seen from the side; camera 31 looks down from above, so not there).
